sections.section: RULES - Attorney-General For Pakistan (Terms and Conditons) Rules 2011
sections.description:
ATTORNEY-GENERAL FOR PAKISTAN (TERMS
ATTORNEY-GENERAL FOR
PAKISTAN (TERMS
AND CONDITONS) RULES, 2011
(Substitution of R.2)
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part II,
22nd January, 2013]
S.R.O.31(I)/2013,
dated 16-1-2013.---In exercise of the powers conferred by Article 100 of the Constitution
of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, the President is pleased to direct that in
the Attorney-General for Pakistan (Terms and Conditions) Rules, 2011, the
following further amendment shall be made and shall be deemed to have been so
made on the 1st day of January, 2013, namely:--
In
the aforesaid Rules, for rule 2, the following shall be substituted, namely:--
"2.
Retainership, perks and privileges, etc.---The Attorney-General for Pakistan
shall be entitled to retainership, perks and privileges as admissible to a
Judge of Supreme Court which are as follows:--
(i)
Salary
Rs.423,414
(ii)
Superior Judicial Allowance (Tax Free)
Rs.196,219
(iii)
Medical Allowance
Rs.15% of the salary
(iv)
Accommodation
Rent free residence maintained by Government with
provision of electricity, gas and water OR Tax free house rent allowance
Rs.68,000 p.m. (if official residence is not provided with provision of
utilities on actual basis and residence to be maintained at Government
expenses.
(v)
Transport
As admissible to a Judge of Supreme Court.
(vi)
TA/DA
As admissible to a Judge of Supreme Court.
(vii)
Medical re-imbursement
As admissible to a Judge of Supreme Court.
(viii)
Telephone (Off/Res.)
As admissible to a Judge of Supreme Court.
(ix)
Leave
As admissible to a Judge of Supreme Court.
